topic: Retain serveStdio handle in process entrypoint
summary: src/index.ts must retain the startServer/serveStdio return handle so stdin keep-alive is not GC-eligible.
details: After loadConfiguration succeeds, assign const serverHandle = startServer(config) and keep the binding live (void serverHandle is fine). Do not call startServer(config) as a discarded expression; dropping the handle can allow GC of the stdio keep-alive and contribute to MCP Connection closed flakes under CI.

topic: Failure-gate stderr flush and Node warning noise
summary: Emit ConfigError/D5 failure lines with writeSync(stderr.fd) before process.exit; set NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 in system spawn/MCP env so one-line stderr asserts stay clean.
details: N-SYS-03 on CI Node 24.22.1 sometimes saw multi-line stderr (asserted 9 lines) that was not locally reproducible. Hardening: sync writeSync so the gate line fully flushes before exit; NODE_NO_WARNINGS in baseSpawnEnv and connectMcpSession env; assertFailureGate messages should include JSON.stringify(lines) when length !== 1 for CI diagnosis. Prefer this over async process.stderr.write for process gates.

topic: MCP stdio Connection closed flake handling
summary: connectMcpSession surfaces child stderr on Connection closed and retries once only when stderr is empty; do not retry when stderr has content.
details: N-SYS-07/N-SYS-05 flaked with Connection closed under CI. Helper wraps failures as McpConnectError with stderr; empty-stderr Connection closed is treated as a stdio race and retried once (~50ms delay); non-empty stderr means a real child failure and must not retry. Always include stderr in the thrown message for triage.

topic: System Vitest worker serialization for MCP stdio
summary: System Vitest project runs with fileParallelism false and maxWorkers 1 because stdio MCP children are sensitive to parallel file workers on CI.
details: vitest.config.ts system project sets fileParallelism: false and maxWorkers: 1. Parallel system files racing multiple dist/index.js stdio children contributed to Connection closed flakes (esp. Node 24.22.1 matrix leg). Keep unit/integration parallelism unchanged unless evidence says otherwise.

topic: CI system-test flake hardening after F1
summary: fix/ci-system-flakes hardens N-SYS-03/05/07 after F1 #56: sync failure stderr, NODE_NO_WARNINGS, MCP empty-stderr Connection closed retry, system Vitest serial, retain serveStdio handle.
details: Follow-up on main after F1 merge (#56 / 299c77f). Scope: src/index.ts writeSync + retain startServer handle; test/helpers/spawn-bin.ts NODE_NO_WARNINGS + richer assertFailureGate; test/helpers/mcp-stdio-client.ts stderr-aware retry; vitest.config.ts system fileParallelism false maxWorkers 1; CHANGELOG note.
